Its outline is not a plain rectangle - it drops deeper over each QSFP-DD block, which Jason describes as two nubs and the photographs confirm.
components.name: agr-filter-top

components.description: Removable BOTTOM air filter for the Edgecore AGR420 (AS7946-74XKSB) - the full-width band of it. The mirror of the top filter and shorter, stopping at panel x 412 rather than running under the management corner. The same physical filter also carries a deeper section beside the QSFP-DD column, which is agr420-filter-step.

components.description: The deep section of an Edgecore AGR420 air filter, beside the QSFP-DD column at the left of the front panel, where the nearest port row is 17 mm away and the frame can drop a second foam cell in. Both the top and the bottom filter carry one; it is not a separate FRU, it is the stepped end of one, split out because a placement is a bounding rectangle.
